problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a set of fragile equipment pieces onto identical transport pallets. The individual pieces are as follows:
* Component Alpha: mass 52 units
* Component Beta: mass 67 units
* Component Gamma: mass 70 units
* Component Delta: mass 69 units
* Component Epsilon: mass 38 units
* Component Zeta: mass 49 units
* Component Eta: mass 54 units
* Component Theta: mass 56 units
* Component Iota: mass 35 units
* Component Kappa: mass 30 units
* Component Lambda: mass 68 units
* Component Mu: mass 42 units

Each pallet is certified for a maximum load capacity of 100 mass units. The objective is to devise an allocation scheme that places every piece onto a pallet, with no piece assigned to more than one pallet, and without exceeding the certified load on any pallet, while minimizing the total number of pallets employed.
